# DS Inventek

> India's only DPIIT-recognized robotics education company founded by actual World Champions. Turnkey school labs, competition-grade courses, and faculty certification — based in Chennai & Puducherry, serving students pan-India online.

DS Inventek is a DPIIT-recognized robotics and AI education company based in Chennai and Puducherry, India, founded by combat-robotics World Champions (Games of the Future 2024, Kazan). It offers hands-on robotics courses for students, and turnkey robotics lab setup, curriculum, and faculty certification services for schools and colleges.

## Courses

- [Basic Electronics & Robotics Foundation](https://www.dsinventek.com/courses/basic-electronics): Learn electronics and robotics fundamentals with hands-on circuit building.
- [Quad Bot – ESP32 Smart Robotics](https://www.dsinventek.com/courses/quad-bot): Build and program a four-legged walking robot using ESP32 with wireless control.
- [Gyro Bot – STM32 Autonomous Robotics](https://www.dsinventek.com/courses/gyro-bot): Master autonomous self-balancing and navigation using STM32 microcontrollers and gyroscopic sensors.

## Services

- [STEM Curriculum Integration](https://www.dsinventek.com/services/edutech-curriculum): NEP 2020-aligned robotics curriculum designed by World Champions. Complete with textbooks, lab kits, and faculty certification.
- [Turnkey Robotics Lab](https://www.dsinventek.com/services/robotics-lab-setup): From empty classroom to fully operational robotics lab in 30 days. We handle design, procurement, installation, and training.
- [Interactive Experience Zones](https://www.dsinventek.com/services/experience-zone): Transform footfall into engagement. Combat robot arenas, AI vision games, and interactive exhibits for public venues.
- [Online Learning Platform](https://www.dsinventek.com/services/online-courses): Learn from World Champions from anywhere in India. Real hardware kits shipped to your door. Live mentorship included.
- [In-Person Training Centers](https://www.dsinventek.com/services/inperson-training): Direct mentorship from World Champions at our Chennai and Puducherry centers. Professional fabrication tools included.
- [Faculty Certification Program](https://www.dsinventek.com/services/trainer-certification): Certify your educators with credentials from World Champions. Industry-recognized, NEP 2020-aligned faculty training.
